merchant/30294.htm.text: Trader Varan: Welcome to our shop, run by my sister and me. Come inside and you won't be disappointed. We offer items in cooperation with Oren's famous magical Ivory Tower and the renowned Dwarven Breath of Flame Guild. My sister is a bit talkative, so coming to me was a wise choice.

links.text: Ask about the local lord and tax rate.

merchant/30294-pk.htm.text: Trader Varan: Our shop must be famous, seeing how wanted criminals brave the danger of town to visit us. Well, it's true that there aren't that many shops with such wonderful items or such a dashing owner. Nonetheless ... Recently, someone broke the law and sold an item to a wanted criminal. He was…

Q00034_InSearchOfCloth/30294-01.html.text: Trader Varan: Ah, you mean Radia's order? Well, I haven't gotten the materials yet. The goods she wants have been rather scarce of late, making them difficult to obtain.

links.text: When can I get it then?

Q00034_InSearchOfCloth/30294-03.html.text: Trader Varan: Please tell Radia that I won't make a mistake like this again.

Q00034_InSearchOfCloth/30294-02.html.text: Trader Varan: Tell her I'm sorry I couldn't fill the order on time, and that I accept responsibility for the breach of Contract.
